title: 4 Days Canadian Rockies Fall or Spring Tour
blurb:
Explore the stunning Canadian Rockies during the vibrant transition of fall and spring with this 4-day adventure. Witness breathtaking landscapes as you travel to Banff and Lake Louise, enjoying free time for hikes and scenic views. Experience local culture with a night of pizza and bowling in Banff. Special Halloween tours include a visit to Pete Murray’s Corn Farm for pumpkin fun. This tour is perfect for students and groups looking for a unique experience in nature and camaraderie.

- 4 days of guided exploration through the Rockies, from Vancouver to Golden
- Enjoy hotel accommodations in Revelstoke, Banff, and Golden
- Unique activities like pizza and bowling night, and optional Banff Gondola ride
- Includes all park passes and three breakfasts, with opportunities for wildlife sightings
